thread.title: Apple (AAPL) to Release Earnings on Tuesday

author: Bonnie Powley
title: Apple (AAPL) to Release Earnings on Tuesday
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) is scheduled to post its quarterly earnings results after the market closes on Tuesday, May 1st. Analysts expect Apple to post earnings of $2.84 per share for the quarter.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the firm earned $3.36 EPS. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. On average, analysts expect Apple to post $11 EPS for the current fiscal year and $12 EPS for the next fiscal year. The company has a market capitalization of $823,613.88, a P/E ratio of 17.62, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.24 and a beta of 1.25.
